'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]], [[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] strikes kill at least 30 people, including six children, at a [[humanitarian aid to Gaza|water collection]] zone, bringing the official death toll in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] to over 58,000. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-gaza-hamas-war-news-07-13-2025-5e76320974342d97f068d0673d2c8847 (AP)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab militants]] claim the takeover of Tardo Village in the [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiiraan region]] of Somalia's [[Hirshabelle|Hirshabelle state]], which was previously captured by [[Ma'awisley]] fighters and the [[Somali National Army]] in September 2022. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/al-shabaab-seizes-key-village-in-central-somalia-amid-escalating-battle (Garowe Online)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-shabaab-captures-central-somali-town-presses-with-advance-2025-07-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***At least 48 civilians are killed, houses are razed and property is [[looting|looted]] in an attack when [[Rapid Support Forces]] fighters storm the village of Um Garfa in [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/paramilitary-attack-kills-48-in-central-sudan-village-war-monitor-053f85fd (''Barron's'')]
*[[Syrian civil war#Fall of the Assad regime, transitional government (2024–present)|Aftermath<!--per the sources in the articles--> of the Syrian civil war]]
**[[Southern Syria clashes (July 2025-present)|Southern Syria clashes]]
***More than 30 people are killed and 100 others are injured in clashes between pro-government forces and [[Druze]] fighters in [[Suwayda]], [[Suwayda Governorate]], Syria. [https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-30-dead-100-injured-in-clashes-between-armed-groups-in-southern-city-of-sweida-say-syrian-officials-13396334 (Sky News)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/more-than-30-killed-in-sectarian-clashes-in-syrias-sweida-interior-ministry-says (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Islamic State]]-affiliated [[Allied Democratic Forces]] insurgents kill at least 66 people in [[Irumu Territory|Territory of Irumu]], in the [[Ituri Province]] of the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/allied-democratic-forces-congo-attack-irumu-ituri-657034df1abab3f76c1951ad575cf654 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Arizona wildfires]]
**The [[Grand Canyon Lodge]] in [[Arizona]], [[United States]], is destroyed by the [[Dragon Bravo Fire]]. [https://apnews.com/article/grand-canyon-wildfire-lodge-north-rim-f3510c22a6fddc9ff1322dbd450aedb8 (AP)]
*[[2025 Fall River assisted-living fire]]
**Nine people are killed and more than 30 others are injured, including five firefighters, in a fire at an [[assisted living]] facility in [[Fall River, Massachusetts|Fall River]], [[Massachusetts]], United States. [https://www.wpri.com/news/local-news/se-mass/crews-battling-fire-at-assisted-living-facility-in-fall-river/ (WPRI-TV)]
*[[Zeusch Aviation Flight 1]]
**A [[Beechcraft King Air B200]] aircraft crashes and catches fire shortly after taking off from [[London Southend Airport]] in [[Southend-on-Sea]], [[England]], killing all four people onboard. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2574934-klein-vliegtuig-van-nederlands-bedrijf-neergestort-bij-londen-southend-airport (NOS)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/southend-airport-plane-crash-victims-latest-updates-b2788176.html (''The Independent'')]
*A bus plunges into a ravine near [[Chakri, Rawalpindi|Chakri]], [[Pakistan]], killing six and injuring 38. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2555696/six-dead-38-injured-as-bus-plunges-into-ravine-near-chakri-interchange (''The Express Tribune'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*''[[E. Jean Carroll v. Donald J. Trump]]'', [[Donald Trump sexual misconduct allegations]], [[Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump]]
** The [[United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit]] rejects [[Donald Trump]]'s second bid to overturn the civil ruling of ''Carroll II'' (2022), upholding that Trump must pay US$5,000,000 to [[E. Jean Carroll]] for [[sexual abuse]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-appeals-court-wont-reconsider-trumps-5-million-loss-e-jean-carroll-2025-06-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Lexington shootings]]
**At least three people, including the perpetrator, are killed, and three others are injured, including a [[Kentucky State Police|state trooper]] and one critically, in two [[spree killer|spree shootings]] in [[Lexington, Kentucky]], United States. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/kentucky-shootings-rcna218553 (NBC News)] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/07/church-shooting-in-lexington-kentucky-kills-2-trooper-among-injured/ (BNO News)]
*Three people are killed in a raid by the [[Haitian National Police]] on drug traffickers, seizing 1,045 kilograms of cocaine on a boat near [[Tortuga (Haiti)|Tortuga]], [[Nord-Ouest (department)|Nord-Ouest]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/haiti/article310645715.html (''Miami Herald'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 FIFA Club World Cup]]
**In [[association football]], English club [[Chelsea F.C.]] win the [[FIFA Club World Cup]] for the second time, defeating French club [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]] 3–0 in the [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup final|final]]. Chelsea [[Winger (association football)|winger]] [[Cole Palmer]] is awarded the tournament's [[Golden Ball (FIFA Club World Cup)|Golden Ball]]. [https://www.fifa.com/en/match-centre/match/10005/289175/289190/400019210 (FIFA)]
*[[2025 Major League Baseball draft]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[Major League Baseball draft|MLB draft]] is held at the [[Coca-Cola Roxy]] in [[Cumberland, Georgia|Cumberland]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], U.S., with the [[Washington Nationals]] selecting [[Eli Willits]] as the [[List of first overall Major League Baseball draft picks|first overall pick]]. At the age of 17, Willits becomes the 3rd youngest player in MLB draft history to be selected first overall. [https://www.mlb.com/news/eli-willits-drafted-no-1-by-nationals-in-2025-mlb-draft (ESPN)]
*[[2025 Wimbledon Championships]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Jannik Sinner]] defeats [[Alcaraz–Sinner rivalry|his rival]] and [[2024 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles|defending champion]] [[Carlos Alcaraz]] in the [[2025 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles| men's singles final]] 4–6, 6–4, 6–4, 6–4 to win his first [[Wimbledon Championships|Wimbledon]] title. Sinner is the first [[Tennis in Italy|Italian]] player to win a singles title at Wimbledon. [https://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/45732583/jannik-sinner-defeats-carlos-alcaraz-rematch-win-wimbledon-2025-men-singles-title (ESPN)]
